answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the wharf of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The knoll lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
